Use FIRST FIRE offline

Take the scientific archive, research chat and drivable 3D rover into a classroom without internet. Download the core once. Add the original rover documents and preview film if you want to open those files offline.

Download the core

The core includes the 20 original PSI CSV tables, 1,058 normalized observations, forecast and timestamp, flight-frame example, physics and engineering models, local rover terrain, telemetry and parts, field guide, classroom material and judge films. Existing optional model downloads and the original publishers’ websites still require internet when first accessed. The bundled archive chat works immediately.

Install and drive

  1. Extract the core ZIP into an empty directory. For each optional ZIP, extract into that same parent directory, merging the included FIRST-FIRE folder. The complete edition puts everything in this folder in one extraction.
  2. Open a terminal in the extracted FIRST-FIRE folder and start a local server. Python 3 is required for this command.
    python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1
    On Windows, use py -3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1.
  3. Visit the local FIRST FIRE site. To drive immediately, open the local 3D rover, choose Drive, focus the scene and use the controls. Keep the terminal open while using the site.
Extract several packs from the command line

Place only the downloaded FIRST FIRE packs in one new directory. Run the command there. It merges each archive into the same folder.

macOS or Linux

for file in first-fire-*.zip; do unzip -o "$file" -d .; done

Windows PowerShell

Get-ChildItem first-fire-*.zip | ForEach-Object { Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $_.FullName -DestinationPath . -Force }

To inspect file integrity, open the pack inventory for supplement hashes and archived paths. checksums.json identifies the downloaded ZIPs on the hosted site and the extracted core files in your installation. Use the public downloads page to obtain additional packs later.
